entities.summary: Alfonso Maria Mistrangelo Sch. P. was an Italian prelate of the Catholic Church. He served as Archbishop of Florence from 1899 until his death, and was elevated to the cardinalate in 1915. He was also a member of the Piarists religious congregation.
